title: Sebbytv2's terrible first mod
description: this is my first mod and its bad
body:
# this is my first mod and its bad
theres some bugs (like coins not showing up in the creative inventory), BUT I WILL FIX THEM >:D

## new things you wouldn't find on your own
- new dimension, the dark dimension, its iron blocks and a coal thing in the bad tab
- theres a new command, /explode, this is self explaintory
- thheres coin ore, can be made into a coin pickaxe with a trash texture, can break almost everything except for the fact it has 1 durability, so use this wisely!
- new villager trade with coin for coin pickaxe, idk why but why not then?
- theres a new object called "interesting button", made with iron and redstone, just dont right click it...
- theres a new block called "dont touch", just dont touch it...
- theres a new liquid called "mysterious liquid", does nothing than look like the mysterious liquid that lands on you as you take out the trash
- theres wood armor, sadly its not craftable :(
- theres a guy spawn egg for testing, dont ask about the texture lol


**this is it i think, if i missed anything im probaly gonna get in trouble D:**
